views.name: cards_by_set
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  setCode,
  COUNT(*) AS card_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN rarity IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS rarity_not_null_count,
  AVG(convertedManaCost) AS avg_convertedManaCost,
  MIN(convertedManaCost) AS min_convertedManaCost,
  MAX(convertedManaCost) AS max_convertedManaCost,
  SUM(CASE WHEN isPromo = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS promo_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN hasFoil = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS foil_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN hasNonFoil = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nonfoil_count
FROM cards
GROUP BY setCode
views.description: Aggregate counts and summary stats per setCode. Useful for set-level reports like card counts by rarity and average mana cost. One row per setCode. | Use for: How many cards are in each set?; Average/Min/Max mana cost per set; Counts of promo/foil/nonfoil printings per set

views.name: card_legalities_wide
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  uuid,
  MAX(CASE WHEN format = 'commander' THEN status END) AS commander_status,
  MAX(CASE WHEN format = 'standard' THEN status END) AS standard_status,
  MAX(CASE WHEN format = 'modern' THEN status END) AS modern_status,
  MAX(CASE WHEN format = 'legacy' THEN status END) AS legacy_status,
  MAX(CASE WHEN format = 'pauper' THEN status END) AS pauper_status
FROM legalities
GROUP BY uuid
views.description: Pivot legalities into one row per card uuid with one column per format containing the status. Useful to quickly filter cards by being Legal/Banned in specific formats without multiplying rows. | Use for: Find cards that are Legal in a given format; Compare legality across multiple formats for a card

views.name: foreign_data_by_language
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  id,
  uuid,
  language,
  name,
  text,
  flavorText,
  type,
  multiverseid
FROM foreign_data

semantic_filters.language: use to restrict to a specific language (e.g. 'English')

views.description: Subset of foreign_data retaining one row per (uuid, language). Useful when you want localized card fields for a specific language or to join a single-language translation to cards. Keep 'language' in semantic_filters when using. | Use for: Retrieve card names/text in a chosen language; Compare flavor text across languages; Join a single-language translation to cards for display

views.name: latest_ruling_per_card
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  id,
  uuid,
  date,
  text,
  RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY uuid ORDER BY date DESC) AS ruling_date_rank
FROM rulings
views.description: For each card uuid, pick the most recent ruling (by date). Exposes ruling_date_rank so callers can select top-N rulings per card if desired. Use this to attach the latest ruling text to cards without multiplying rows. | Use for: Attach the latest ruling to each card; List the most recent N rulings per card

views.name: sets_with_translation
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  s.id AS id,
  s.code AS code,
  s.name AS name,
  s.block AS block,
  s.type AS type,
  s.releaseDate AS releaseDate,
  st.language AS language,
  st.translation AS translation
FROM sets s
LEFT JOIN set_translations st ON s.code = st.setCode
views.description: Denormalized view of sets left-joined to their translations. One row per set translation (setCode + language). Use to present set metadata with localized names. Keep setCode or language filters externally to avoid multiplication. | Use for: Show sets with translations in a chosen language; Filter sets by releaseDate and display localized name

views.name: cards_with_set_and_latest_ruling
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.id,
  c.uuid,
  c.name,
  c.setCode,
  s.name AS set_name,
  s.releaseDate AS releaseDate,
  lr.date AS latest_ruling_date,
  lr.text AS latest_ruling_text
FROM cards c
LEFT JOIN sets s ON c.setCode = s.code
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT id, uuid, date, text
  FROM (
    SELECT id, uuid, date, text,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY uuid ORDER BY date DESC) AS ruling_date_rank
    FROM rulings
  ) WHERE ruling_date_rank = 1
) lr ON c.uuid = lr.uuid
views.description: Denormalized card-level relation joined to set metadata and the latest ruling (if any). One row per card.id; joins to rulings are restricted by selecting ruling_date_rank = 1 in an inner SELECT to avoid multiplying by multiple rulings. | Use for: Show cards with their set and most recent ruling; Filter cards by set releaseDate and inspect latest ruling
